settings.heading: How to apply your transfer.
settings.lede: Heat-press your DTF transfer onto any cotton, polyester, blend, or nylon garment in six steps. Works with a household iron in a pinch.

settings.title: Set up your press
settings.body: Pre-heat your heat press to 150°C. A household iron also works — set to its highest cotton setting and turn off the steam.

settings.title: Position the transfer
settings.body: Place the garment flat on the press. Put the DTF transfer onto the print area with the film side facing up and the ink side touching the fabric. Cover with the included parchment paper.
settings.spec:
Garment: Cotton, Poly, Blend, or Nylon
Film side: Up
Cover: Parchment paper

settings.title: First press
settings.body: Press for 15 seconds at 150°C with medium-firm pressure. The film bonds the ink into the fabric weave during this initial press.

settings.title: Cool peel
settings.body: Let the transfer cool fully before peeling — about 60 seconds. Peel the film off slowly at a low angle. If any ink lifts with the film, lay it back down and press again for 5 seconds.
settings.spec:
Cool time: 60s
Peel angle: Low
Peel speed: Slow

settings.title: Second press
settings.body: Cover the print with parchment paper and press again for 10 seconds. This locks in the durability and softens the hand of the print.
settings.spec:
Time: 10s
Cover: Parchment paper
Pressure: Medium-firm

settings.title: Wash care
settings.body: Wait 24 hours before the first wash. Always wash inside-out on cold. Tumble dry low or air dry. Iron only on the reverse side. Prints are rated for 100+ washes when cared for this way.
settings.spec:
First wash: 24hr after
Water: Cold
Direction: Inside-out
Dry: Low or air

settings.heading: Talk to us.
settings.sub: If a transfer isn't behaving, send us a photo. We'll diagnose the issue and replace the print at no charge if it was on us.
